rationale: Both candidates deeply and correctly nail the core live ground-truth issue (gcanlin/R2-Y's cudagraph-mode/seed-under-full-cudagraphs concern), with concrete file:line evidence. Y more directly maps to named reviewer asks (Sy0307's seed-removal/benchmark-attribution concern, verified via grep) and backs nearly every claim with literal quoted evidence, reducing fabrication risk; it also independently finds the duplicate-assignment bug with base-vs-diff verification. X contributes one genuinely valuable diff-grounded catch Y misses (asymmetric use_cuda_graphs vs. outer-wrap conditions on GPU, which Y actually mis-validates as 'resolved') and is somewhat more actionable with inline ready-to-apply code diffs, but leans on a few deeper, harder-to-verify speculative claims (e.g. fish_speech_slow_ar.py internals) that add precision risk.
